name: s81ctrl_rg3w-rg3w-COMMIT
purpose: S81 CTRL rg3 (MU.BAL.SX.3): n32s controller + non-inline index reader client face (rrq/rrd), wide re-floorplan main

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_ctrl_rg3 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DS81CTRL_SRAM_FIFO -DS81CTRL_SRAM_P192 -DS81CTRL_NATIVE32 --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_afifo.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_afifo_g.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_ctrl_pcr.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/dsfd_rly_masters_dv276.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/ot_s81ph_afifo_g_sram.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192_bb.v rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/dsfd_ctrl_rg3.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg3w/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg3w/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81ctrl_rg3w --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_ctrl_rg3 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_16x340_p192 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-COLLECT/RG3 10-21 structural re-floorplan of dsfd_ctrl_rg3 after the rg3/rg3s regate CTS FAIL (388.8 x 324 2x2 SRAMs left a 29 um N band and 43 um S band for 3.1k face pins + io flops: faces 98% spanned, PHY-face hold repair stuck k_rdy->krq_c -23.7 ps / ld[0] -71 ps, GPL overflow 36.7% tiles): outline 561.6 x 324 (aspect 1.73), the 4 SRAM FIFOs as two abutted N-S stacks, one per PC (x 86.4 / 345.6; u_q R0 at y 64.8 pins toward S, u_r MX on top at y 165.522 pins toward N, bare touching faces), so S (PHY, 64.8 um) and N (stream+reader, 57.7 um) are full-width macro-free std-cell bands plus a 144.7 um centre column. Same RTL/defines as rg3. Pin plan: N face per PC half (PC0 rq rd rrq rrd | clk ck_o | PC1 rq rd rrq rrd) 1,882 pins over 553 um = 3.4 pins/um alternating M3/M5; S = n32s PHY pins re-spread 1,245 over 553 um = 2.3/um; rst_n W mid.
